title: Inclusionary Zoning — Core Overview (Edition 1)
description: Inclusionary zoning requires or incentivizes developers to set aside a share of new units at below-market rents. Programs typically pair the mandate with density bonuses so projects remain financially viable. This overview edition presents Inclusionary Zoning as a core housing concept for contemporary cities.

principles: Add supply at many price points
Locate homes near jobs and transit

real_examples.fact: Hundreds of cities use inclusionary zoning to produce income-restricted homes.

spec.source_note: Core facts verified from public sources.
